criteria.label: Problem Urgency
criteria.description: Users have a painful, recurring problem they'll pay monthly to solve
fixSuggestions: Focus on workflow that happens daily/weekly
Target moment of acute pain (hiring, scaling, compliance)
Quantify time/money cost of not solving

criteria.label: Willingness to Pay
criteria.description: Target customers have budget and habit of paying for software
fixSuggestions: Focus on industries with SaaS culture

criteria.label: Retention & Stickiness
criteria.description: Product becomes essential and hard to leave
fixSuggestions: Store customer data that grows over time
Integrate with other tools they use

criteria.label: Acquisition Economics
criteria.description: Cost to acquire customers relative to lifetime value
riskIndicators: Low LTV (high churn or low price)

criteria.label: Competitive Moat
criteria.description: Defensibility against competitors and new entrants
fixSuggestions: Build integrations that increase switching costs

failurePatterns.description: Nice-to-have product that users don't urgently need
High churn rate makes growth unsustainable
Costs more to acquire customers than they're worth
Building features without solving core problem deeply

alternativeModels: Vertical SaaS (deep focus on one industry)
